name: Spotify MCP Server
description: Enables control of Spotify playback through OAuth authentication, including play/pause, track navigation, volume control, device management, and searching/playing songs by artist or track name.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your Spotify Client Secret from the Spotify Developer Dashboard
